mLocKeys.keySummary: Damage and slow nearby enemies, fearing minions and monsters.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Volibear roars, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to nearby enemies and <status>Slowing</status> by @SlowPercent*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds. Minions and monsters are <status>Feared</status> as well.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Gain Move Speed and flip an enemy with your next attack.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Volibear drops to all fours to hunt his enemies, gaining @BaseMoveSpeed*100@% Move Speed for @Duration@ seconds, enhanced to @ChaseMoveSpeed*100@% Move Speed toward enemy Champions.

Volibear's next attack during this time deals @TotalAttackDamage@ physical damage and flings the target behind him.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Basic attacks deal chain lightning damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Volibear channels the storm for @Duration@ seconds, causing his basic attacks to deal an additional <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>, chaining to @ChainTargets@ nearby enemies.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Attacks grant Attack Speed. At full stacks, bite an enemy for damage that increases as their Health falls.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Volibear gains @AttackSpeedPerStack*100@% Attack Speed with each attack, stacking up to @MaxStacks@ times for @MaximumAttackSpeed@ Attack Speed.

Active: When Volibear has @MaxStacks@ stacks of Frenzy, he can bite an enemy to deal @BiteDamage@ physical damage, scaling with the target's missing Health for a maximum of @MaximumDamage@ physical damage.
